description_en: Queries the details of a DataWorks workspace
description_zh: 该接口用于查询一个DataWorks工作空间的详细信息
name: GetProject

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/workspace/list) and go to the workspace management page to obtain the ID.

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks 工作空间的 ID。您可以登录 DataWorks 控制台 (https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/workspace/list)，进入工作空间管理页面获取 ID。

该参数用来确定本次 API 调用操作使用的 DataWorks 工作空间
parameters.name: id

AliyunResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group to which the workspace belongs
AliyunResourceGroupId.description_zh: 工作空间所属阿里云资源组ID

Description.example: Financial analysis group project data development

DevEnvironmentEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the development environment is enabled. Valid values:

true: The development environment is enabled for the workspace, which supports isolation between the development and production environments.

false: Only the production environment is used
DevEnvironmentEnabled.description_zh:
是否启用开发环境：

true 工作空间启用开发环境，支持开发与生产环境隔离。

false 仅使用生产环境

DevRoleDisabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the development role is disabled. Valid values:

false: The development role is enabled.

true: The development role is disabled
DevRoleDisabled.description_zh:
是否禁用开发角色：

false，开启开发角色

true，禁用开发角色

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the workspace

Owner.description_en: The user ID of the workspace owner, which is the Alibaba Cloud account ID
Owner.description_zh: 工作空间拥有者UserId，即阿里云账号ID

PaiTaskEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether PAI task scheduling is enabled. Valid values:

true: You can create Machine Learning Platform for AI (PAI) nodes in the DataWorks workspace and run them on a periodic schedule based on the node configurations.

false: PAI task scheduling is disabled
PaiTaskEnabled.description_zh:
是否启用PAI任务调度：

true 可以在DataWorks工作空间创建机器学习（PAI）节点，并按照节点配置进行周期性调度运行。

false 禁用PAI任务调度

Status.description_en:
The workspace status. Valid values:

Available: The workspace is running normally.
Initializing: The workspace is being initialized.
InitFailed: The workspace failed to be initialized.
Forbidden: The workspace is manually disabled.
Deleting: The workspace is being deleted.
DeleteFailed: The workspace failed to be deleted.
Frozen: The workspace is frozen due to overdue payment.
Updating: The workspace is being updated.
UpdateFailed: The workspace failed to be updated
Status.description_zh:
空间状态：

Available：工作空间运行正常
Initializing：初始化工作空间
InitFailed：工作空间初始化失败
Forbidden：手动禁用工作空间
Deleting：正在删除工作空间
DeleteFailed：工作空间删除失败
Frozen：工作空间欠费冻结
Updating：更新工作空间中
UpdateFailed：更新工作空间失败

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID，用于定位日志，排查问题
